voyants.signification: Anti-lock braking system (ABS) disabled or faulty (wheel speed sensor, wiring, control unit)
voyants.action: Braking remains possible but without ABS assistance; drive carefully and have the system checked within the week

voyants.signification: Fault in the parking assist system (proximity sensors)
voyants.action: Exercise extra caution when manoeuvring; have the sensors checked if the fault persists

voyants.signification: Malfunction in the passive safety system (airbags, seatbelt pretensioners)
voyants.action: The vehicle can be driven normally, but airbags may not deploy correctly in a crash; have the system diagnosed promptly

voyants.signification: Fault or activation of the vehicle’s anti-theft alarm system
voyants.action: Check the central locking system is working properly; have the system checked if false alarms occur

voyants.signification: Fault in the forward collision warning system (emergency braking assist)
voyants.action: Maintain a safe distance manually; have the system checked if the fault persists

voyants.signification: System detects signs of drowsiness or reduced driver alertness (driving behaviour analysis)
voyants.action: Stop as soon as possible for a break; do not ignore the alert

voyants.signification: Fault or deactivation of the lane-keeping assist system
voyants.action: Stay alert to your lane position; have the camera/sensor system checked if necessary

voyants.signification: Excessive temperature in the automatic gearbox oil
voyants.action: Stop and allow the gearbox to cool; avoid straining the transmission

voyants.signification: Malfunction in the exhaust gas treatment system (catalytic converter or SCR)
voyants.action: Have the system diagnosed promptly; this fault may lead to a refusal at the *contrôle technique* (MOT test)

voyants.signification: The ignition key is not recognised by the control unit, preventing the engine from starting
voyants.action: Try a spare key; contact the manufacturer or an auto locksmith if the problem persists

voyants.signification: Fault in the emergency brake assist system (sudden braking detection)
voyants.action: Drive carefully and anticipate braking; have the system checked

voyants.signification: Electrical charging issue: faulty alternator, end-of-life battery, or broken alternator belt
voyants.action: Turn off non-essential electrical consumers; reach a garage quickly to avoid total electrical failure (loss of power steering, assisted braking)

voyants.signification: Serious fault in the high-voltage battery pack (400V to 800V depending on vehicle) powering the electric drive
voyants.action: Stop safely, switch off the ignition, do not handle the battery yourself, and contact a qualified high-voltage assistance service

voyants.signification: Confirms that the electric/hybrid plug-in vehicle is correctly connected to a charging station
voyants.action: Check the charging progress on the dedicated screen or app

voyants.signification: The control unit detects a pressure leak in the fuel evaporation system, often due to a loose filler cap
voyants.action: Check that the fuel filler cap is screwed on correctly until it clicks

voyants.signification: Electronic or mechanical fault in the automatic gearbox, switching to restricted operation (often locked in one gear)
voyants.action: Avoid high revs; reach a garage promptly for a transmission diagnosis

voyants.signification: The bonnet is not properly locked
voyants.action: Check and close the bonnet before driving

voyants.signification: Confirms activation of the automatic wiper mode controlled by the rain sensor
One or more seatbelts are not fastened
voyants.action: Fasten the seatbelt; the warning light will turn off automatically once all seatbelts are secured

voyants.signification: Confirms that the air conditioning system is active
The key or keyless card is not detected inside the vehicle
voyants.action: Check the key is present; replace the card battery if the problem persists

voyants.signification: The boot is not properly locked
voyants.action: Check the boot is closed before driving

voyants.signification: Clogged air filter restricting engine air intake
voyants.action: Have the air filter replaced at the next service

voyants.signification: Reminder of the mandatory periodic *contrôle technique* (MOT test) deadline
voyants.action: Schedule the *contrôle technique* before the regulatory deadline

voyants.signification: Fault or activation of the differential lock (torque distribution between wheels on the same axle)
voyants.action: Have the system checked at a garage if the warning light stays on abnormally

voyants.signification: Fault in the electric or hydraulic power steering system
voyants.action: Steering remains possible but becomes much harder; drive carefully to the nearest garage

voyants.signification: Fault detected in the ignition system (spark plugs, coils) which may cause engine misfires
voyants.action: If the warning light flashes (misfire), avoid revving the engine and have the system diagnosed promptly to protect the catalytic converter

voyants.signification: Fault in the electronic control system of an automated manual gearbox
voyants.action: Have the system diagnosed promptly; the gearbox may lock in one gear

voyants.signification: General electrical fault detected by the vehicle’s multiplexed network (CAN bus)
voyants.action: Have the vehicle’s electrical network diagnosed at a garage

voyants.signification: Fault in the fuel level sensor in the fuel tank, making the gauge unreliable
voyants.action: Monitor fuel consumption by mileage as a backup; have the sensor checked

voyants.signification: Fault in the vehicle speed sensor, which may affect the speedometer, ABS, or automatic gearbox
voyants.action: Have an OBD diagnosis performed; this fault may disable other dependent safety systems

voyants.signification: An exterior bulb (headlight, brake light, indicator) is faulty or blown
voyants.action: Replace the faulty bulb promptly; a defective light is dangerous and may result in a penalty

voyants.signification: Fault detected in the rear-view camera or its display
voyants.action: Exercise extra caution when reversing; have the camera checked

voyants.signification: Fault in the adaptive cruise control system (radar/camera for distance detection)
voyants.action: Resume manual speed control; have the radar sensor checked

voyants.signification: Fault in the windscreen wiper motor or washer fluid circuit
voyants.action: Have the system checked; verify the associated fuses

voyants.signification: Fault detected in one or more fuel injectors
voyants.action: Have an OBD diagnosis performed as soon as possible; avoid revving the engine

voyants.signification: Fault in the adaptive headlight system (directional lighting following the steering angle)
voyants.action: Have the adaptive lighting system checked

voyants.signification: Fault detected in the lambda sensor, affecting the air/fuel mixture and emissions
voyants.action: Have an OBD diagnosis performed; a faulty sensor increases fuel consumption and emissions

voyants.signification: Confirms activation of the rear window heating element (and mirrors on some models)
voyants.action: Remember to deactivate once demisting is complete to save energy

voyants.signification: Fault or deactivation of the blind spot monitoring system
voyants.action: Exercise extra caution when changing lanes; have the system checked if the alert persists

voyants.signification: Fault in the EGR valve, often clogged, preventing proper exhaust gas recirculation
voyants.action: Have an OBD diagnosis performed; a clogged EGR valve is a common cause of the engine warning light

voyants.signification: Electronic stability programme manually disabled or faulty (angle, speed, or acceleration sensor)
voyants.action: Check if the ESP button was accidentally deactivated; if the warning light stays on without user action, have the system diagnosed

voyants.signification: Scheduled maintenance interval reached (mileage or time); manufacturer service reminder
voyants.action: Schedule the service at a garage or dealership as soon as possible

voyants.signification: Confirms activation of front or rear fog lights
voyants.action: Use only in reduced visibility conditions (fog, heavy rain, snow)

voyants.signification: Confirms activation of full beam headlights
voyants.action: Switch to dipped headlights when approaching another vehicle

voyants.signification: Clogged cabin filter (pollen filter) reducing interior air quality and ventilation flow
voyants.action: Have the cabin filter replaced at the next service

voyants.voyant: Fuel filter clogged / water in diesel
voyants.signification: Water detected in the diesel fuel filter, or filter clogging
voyants.action: Have the water drained from the fuel filter promptly to avoid damaging the injection system

voyants.signification: Clogged diesel particulate filter, requiring regeneration (burning off accumulated particles)
voyants.action: Drive for a few minutes on a main road or motorway at sustained revs to allow automatic regeneration; if the warning light remains on, consult a garage

voyants.signification: Parking brake (handbrake or electronic) engaged
voyants.action: Release the handbrake before driving; if the warning light stays on with the brake released, this may indicate a braking circuit issue

voyants.signification: Loss of GPS signal or fault with the onboard navigation system
voyants.action: Use road signs for guidance temporarily; the signal usually returns when leaving covered areas (tunnels, car parks)

voyants.signification: Electronic anti-theft system active or faulty, preventing engine start
voyants.action: Check the correct key is being used; if the fault persists, seek professional assistance (risk of theft or electronic failure)

voyants.signification: Confirms that the fuel-efficient driving (Eco) mode is active, limiting power to reduce consumption
voyants.action: No action required; deactivate the mode if more power is needed

voyants.signification: Insufficient AdBlue (urea solution) level for reducing nitrogen oxide emissions in SCR diesel engines
voyants.action: Top up the AdBlue level promptly; if the level becomes critical, the warning light will flash then stay on, and the vehicle may refuse to restart

voyants.signification: Traction battery charge reaching a low level (around 10-12% depending on the model), limited range remaining
voyants.action: Recharge the vehicle as soon as possible; plan a stop at a charging station

voyants.signification: Fuel reserve reached, low remaining range
voyants.action: Refuel as soon as possible to avoid running out of fuel

voyants.signification: Current charge level of the traction battery
voyants.action: Monitor the level to anticipate recharging needs

voyants.signification: Insufficient gearbox oil level (manual or automatic)
voyants.action: Have the gearbox oil level checked and topped up promptly to avoid premature wear

voyants.signification: Insufficient brake fluid level in the reservoir, often linked to worn brake pads or a leak
voyants.action: Stop as soon as possible, check the level, do not drive with degraded braking, contact a garage

voyants.signification: Insufficient coolant level in the circuit, risk of engine overheating
voyants.action: Stop, allow the engine to cool, check and top up the level, inspect for leaks

voyants.signification: Insufficient windscreen washer fluid in the reservoir
voyants.action: Top up the windscreen washer fluid as soon as possible

voyants.signification: One or more doors are not properly closed
voyants.action: Check and close the relevant door properly before driving

voyants.signification: Insufficient oil pressure in the engine lubrication circuit
voyants.action: Stop the engine immediately as soon as it is safe to do so, check the oil level, do not restart without inspection

voyants.signification: Pressure loss detected in one or more tyres, typically around 25% below the programmed nominal pressure
voyants.action: Check the pressure of all four tyres as soon as possible (at a service station), look for slow punctures

voyants.signification: Glow plugs heating the cylinders (normal on start-up) or fault if the warning light flashes/remains on
voyants.action: Wait for the light to go out before starting in cold weather; if the light flashes while driving, have the pre-heating circuit checked

voyants.signification: Confirms activation of cabin or battery thermal preconditioning before use or charging
voyants.action: No action required; comfort/optimisation feature activated

voyants.signification: Confirms that cruise control or speed limiter is active
voyants.action: Check the set speed before driving

voyants.signification: Indicates that the diesel particulate filter regeneration process is underway
voyants.action: Continue driving on a main road at sustained revs until the regeneration cycle completes

voyants.signification: First-level generic alert indicating a major malfunction requiring immediate vehicle stop, often accompanied by a specific message on the display
voyants.action: Stop as soon as safely possible and check the associated message or vehicle handbook

voyants.signification: Manufacturer’s owner alert indicating that a service or inspection is required
voyants.action: Refer to the vehicle handbook to identify the exact nature of the alert and schedule the intervention

voyants.signification: Fault with the speed-sensitive power steering system
voyants.action: Have the system checked; steering may feel heavier or lighter than usual

voyants.signification: Automatic stop-start system manually disabled or unavailable (low battery, engine temperature, bonnet open)
voyants.action: Check the conditions required for operation (engine temperature, battery charge) if the deactivation is not intentional

voyants.signification: Fault with the air suspension system (ride height, compressor)
voyants.action: Avoid heavy loads and rough roads; have the system checked promptly

voyants.signification: Fault with the hybrid or electric powertrain management system
voyants.action: Have the system diagnosed promptly at an approved high-voltage specialist

voyants.signification: TPMS can no longer monitor tyre pressure, often after a wheel change without recalibration
voyants.action: Recalibrate the TPMS via the vehicle menu after changing tyres or wheels

voyants.signification: Confirms activation of the child safety lock on the rear doors
voyants.action: No action required; check that the relevant doors can only be opened from the outside

voyants.signification: Engine coolant temperature abnormally high, risk of engine overheating
voyants.action: Stop as soon as possible, switch off the engine, allow to cool before checking the coolant level

voyants.signification: Sunroof not properly closed or locked
voyants.action: Check and close the sunroof completely before driving

voyants.signification: Fault with the all-wheel drive system (torque distribution between axles)
voyants.action: Adjust driving according to available grip; have the system checked promptly

voyants.signification: Multi-system generic alert requiring the vehicle’s information display to be checked for the precise fault
voyants.action: Check the detailed message on the dashboard and act accordingly

voyants.signification: Fault with the turbocharging system (pressure, sensor, actuator)
voyants.action: Avoid heavy acceleration; have the turbocharger diagnosed promptly

voyants.signification: Advanced wear of the clutch disc detected by sensor
voyants.action: Have the clutch checked and replaced if necessary before it fails completely

voyants.signification: Brake pad thickness below the minimum wear threshold detected by sensor
voyants.action: Have the brake pads (and discs if needed) checked and replaced promptly at a garage

voyants.signification: Abnormally fast flashing indicator warning light signalling a blown bulb
voyants.action: Replace the faulty indicator bulb promptly to remain visible and compliant

voyants.signification: Indicates that the engine is in its running-in period with recommended rev limit
voyants.action: Follow the manufacturer’s running-in recommendations during the first miles

voyants.signification: Fault detected by the engine control unit (engine management, emissions, sensors)
voyants.action: Avoid long journeys and high revs; have an OBD diagnostic performed as soon as possible. If the light flashes, stop immediately

voyants.signification: On some models (e.g. Dacia), indicates reduced grip risk or traction control activation
voyants.action: Adjust driving to road conditions; check tyre pressures
